scope: EXP-003 historical simulated economic track and forward decision governance

rules.stake_rule: total stake should normally be min(200 MXN, 10% of available bankroll), with positive exposure every jornada while bankroll > 0
rules.selection_priority: rank best available opportunities using frozen model probability, pre-cutoff price and preregistered context diagnostics; do not manufacture weak tickets solely to spend the cap
rules.forward_money_class: REAL only after user confirms manual execution

rationale: The user requires every jornada to generate at least one wager so the learning process does not skip market opportunities.
The prior forced 200 MXN rule created unnecessary exposure when weak tickets were included only to fill a quota.
Dynamic sizing preserves continuous participation while reducing bankroll ruin risk.
Participation obligation and stake-size discipline are separate decisions.
governance_note: This changes staking/portfolio construction only. It does not retune V0.1R probabilities, Dixon-Coles parameters, decay, rho, market support interval or Economic Selector V1 scoring logic.
